name: retro-grid
title: Retro Grid
blurb: Grid recedes into perspective, scrolling endlessly across the background.
description: WebGL-rendered grid in perspective that scrolls continuously; responsive to angle, cellSize, and color props; includes CSS fallback for unsupported browsers.
use_when: Large background effect for hero sections or immersive layouts needing retro 3D aesthetics.
avoid_when: Browsers without WebGL support (CSS fallback is static); performance-sensitive contexts with many concurrent grids.
a11y: Decorative background wrapper. Respects prefers-reduced-motion (animation pauses).
